_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the spawned tests that drive the pre-commit lock guard's exit code.

expectRed: exits 1 naming plan-critic when the review-gate lock exists
resolves the main checkout lock from a worktree
mutations.note: The lock branch prints its reason and exits 0 — a commit lands while a review round is open, which is the defect this guard exists to stop.

expectRed: exits 0 when no review-gate lock exists
mutations.note: The clean path blocks too — every commit is refused whether or not a round is open.

expectRed: resolves the main checkout lock from a worktree
mutations.note: Resolves the checkout's own root instead of the shared common dir — a worktree looks for the lock beside itself, finds none, and commits while the main checkout's round is open.
